a: prefReader reads a stored `null` as the value, where the control shows the default
A condition on an omitted object field reads the default's field, which repair says the field does not have
An alias drawn under its own name keeps the target's `short` forms, so a narrow surface shows the target's abbreviation
prefDisplayBounds sorts and clamps `stops` under a unit and returns them raw without one
A disabled owner's switch exemption never matches a field reading the entry itself (`from: 'item', path: ''`)
b: A union's variants that share a field key share one status: a condition on one variant's field disables (or hides, or activates) the same-keyed field of every other variant
A `minAt`/`maxAt` reading NaN wipes the declared bound it is folded into
`prefReader` recurses without bound on a scoped leaf whose selector is scoped back by it
The list of condition fields is defined twice, in `groupConditions.ts` and in `judge.ts`
